column1: # swarm manifest — single source of truth for what a `cpo` swarm contains.
# Consumed by swarm-init.sh, swarm-sync.sh, and swarm-onboard.sh via
# manifest_walk in swarm-lib.sh, so first-stamp, upgrade, and onboard cannot
# diverge. Add a new artifact in ONE place: here.
# Per-type dispatch: at apply time, swarm_type_of() resolves a repo's archetype
# from its .claude/swarm-type marker; for a cpo swarm the marker is 'cpo' and
# this file is the consumed manifest.
#   - lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored
#   - fields are pipe-delimited, leading/trailing whitespace per field is trimmed
#   - target-path is relative to the target repo
#     (except gitignore, where this field is .gitignore itself; the
#     template-path is the line we ensure is present in it)
#   - The cpo swarm directory IS the operator's product-vision repo. Doctrine
#     and product-template/) is refreshed centrally. Operator-owned content
#     (products/, stress-test-log/) is seeded once and never touched by sync
#   - The permission-gate allows the cpo to push its own vision repo (its
#     function, so the operator can read it), but — via the SAME shared
#     classifier as engineering-cto (_git_push_class in the prelude) — DENIES
#     push to main/master, force-push, and broad/destructive push, and defers
#     anything ambiguous (ADR-0012). The push policy no longer diverges from
#     engineering-cto; both compose against the same _base safety floor.
#   - No TEAM_LEAD, no PROJECT_SPEC/ADR, no test-gate / docs-check /
#     dod-affirm, no pre-commit hook, no test-cmd — the cpo is a single
#     conversational agent, not a team-of-engineers building software.

compose           | cpo/AGENTS.md+_base/CLAUDE.md+_base/SWARM_BEHAVIOR.md                                                        | AGENTS.md | Codex entrypoint plus byte-identical shared doctrine fragments: direct CPO doctrine route and harness enforcement boundaries

refresh           | cpo/hooks/discord-reply-nudge.sh                                                                              | .claude/hooks/discord-reply-nudge.sh | Stop: thin native adapter to the same harness-owned verified delivery/dead-letter/audit policy used by engineering CTO and Codex workers

refresh           | _base/hooks/session-doctrine.sh                                                                               | .claude/hooks/session-doctrine.sh | SessionStart: injects the CPO doctrine-read directive (CONVERSATION/EVALUATION/SURFACING/MEMORY/READINESS_BAR/ESCALATION) into every session — race-free complement to the tmux launch brief
# Codex-native project layer. Command hooks are deliberately neutralized:
# Codex 0.144.x executes trusted hook commands outside its tool sandbox, and a
# definition hash does not make referenced repo scripts immutable. Keep an
# explicit empty hooks file so sync also disables unsafe older Qofi hook sets.

refresh           | _base/codex/rules/qofi-hard-floor.rules                                                                       | .codex/rules/qofi-hard-floor.rules | experimental execpolicy: outside-sandbox forbidden prefixes for unambiguous hard-floor commands
